title: Observe is the dry run
description:
At rung `observe` an agent runs its real procedure with write operations answered by the gate as 'would do', and records what it would have written. This is the one dry-run mechanism for agents; per-feature dry-run flags are not added.

**Acceptance criteria**
- An agent at `observe` changes no record except its own run.
- The run shows what it would have done.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- observe-rung.feature: an observing agent writes nothing; the run lists the intended writes; raising the rung makes the same procedure write.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Observability, safety and release readiness. Slice code J4 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
